title: Television Analog Recording - 1-in Type B Reference Recorders - Records on Reference Tapes
scope: This standard specifies the dimensions and location of video, audio, and tracking-control records on reference tapes for 1-in type B helical-scan video tape recorders, operating on the 525/60 monochrome or NTSC color system, as described in ANSI/SMPTE 29M.
